stamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
task["created_at_utc"] = stamp.isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00","Z")
filename = "user-prompt-task-" + str(int(stamp.timestamp())) + ".json"
path = root + "/" + filename
payload = (json.dumps(task, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
def gh(method, endpoint, body=None):
    args = ["gh","api","--method",method,"-H","Accept: application/vnd.github+json",endpoint]
    if body is not None: args += ["--input","-"]
    p = subprocess.run(args,input=json.dumps(body) if body is not None else None,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError("GitHub API error: " + p.stderr[-1000:])
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
def exists(url):
    p = subprocess.run(["gh","api","--method","GET",url],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=40)
    if p.returncode == 0: return True
    if "HTTP 404" in p.stderr: return False
    raise RuntimeError("Could not establish destination status: " + p.stderr[-900:])
assert not exists("repos/"+repo+"/contents/"+quote(path,safe="/")+"?ref=main"), "Refusing overwrite"
json.loads(payload)
written = gh("PUT","repos/"+repo+"/contents/"+quote(path,safe="/"),{"message":"Queue six-month repository file and expression inventory task","content":base64.b64encode(payload).decode("ascii"),"branch":"main"})
readback = gh("GET","repos/"+repo+"/contents/"+quote(path,safe="/")+"?ref=main")
actual = base64.b64decode(readback["content"])
assert actual == payload, "Full byte readback mismatch"
assert len(actual) == len(payload)
assert json.loads(actual)["task"]["ordered_workflow"][1]["gate"].startswith("The current repository"), "Execution gate not saved"
print(json.dumps({"result":"VERIFIED","path":path,"size_bytes":len(actual),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),"commit":written["commit"]["sha"],"task_type":task["task_type"],"status":task["status"],"stage_count":len(task["task"]["ordered_workflow"])}))
